_note: English one-line field descriptions, stamped onto the schema at metadata() time (emulated/base.py _apply_descriptions). `_shared` applies to every entity; an entity-specific entry wins; an inline description= on a prop() wins over both. Extend per entity as needed — obvious leaves may be omitted.

_shared.object: Type discriminator of the record (its entity name).
_shared.id: The record's stable, unique identifier — use it to read, link (references) and write this record. A typed 'speaking' id (e.g. cus_4711); assigned automatically when the record is created.
_shared.updatedAt: Timestamp the record was last changed.
_shared.tags: Free-text labels for grouping/segmenting the record.
_shared.customFields: Company-specific extra fields defined on this entity.
_shared.addresses: All postal addresses of the partner: one default 'both' row (the main address) plus an optional deviating billing address and any number of shipping addresses. Writing this collection carries the FULL desired set: an entry without an `id` is created, an entry with an `id` is updated, and any entry you omit is DELETED upstream. It is not an append — to change one row, read them all, edit the one, and send the whole list back. `null` means NOT LOADED, not empty: bigger list pages skip the sub-resource read, and a write that carries `null` leaves the collection untouched. Only a list you read from a record (`get`) or a small page is the complete set — never send a `null`-sourced one back as if it were.
_shared.addresses.id: Id of the address row. `adr_main` is the main address and `adr_billing` the deviating billing address (the two singletons); each further shipping address has its own id. Omit on create — it is assigned automatically; supply it to update or keep an existing row.
_shared.addresses.type: Role of the address: billing, shipping, or both (main address).
_shared.addresses.label: Free name for the location, e.g. 'HQ' or 'Lager Nord'.
_shared.addresses.isDefault: Marks the standard address for its type — used unless a document overrides it.
_shared.addresses.name: Recipient / company name on this address.
_shared.addresses.contactPerson: Person to hand the delivery to at this address (free text).
_shared.addresses.gln: Global Location Number (GS1) identifying this location for EDI.
_shared.contacts: Contact persons at the partner (each an individual, differentiated by role/department). Writing this collection carries the FULL desired set: an entry without an `id` is created, an entry with an `id` is updated, and any entry you omit is DELETED upstream. It is not an append — to change one row, read them all, edit the one, and send the whole list back. `null` means NOT LOADED, not empty: bigger list pages skip the sub-resource read, and a write that carries `null` leaves the collection untouched. Only a list you read from a record (`get`) or a small page is the complete set — never send a `null`-sourced one back as if it were.
_shared.contacts.id: Id of the contact person (con_…). Assigned automatically on create — omit it to add a new contact, supply it to update or keep an existing one.
_shared.contacts.isPrimary: Marks the main contact person for the partner.
_shared.contacts.type: Salutation / kind of the contact (mr, mrs, company, other).
_shared.contacts.name: Full name of the contact person.
_shared.contacts.title: Academic / professional title (e.g. Dr.).
_shared.contacts.role: Department or area the contact is responsible for (Purchasing, Accounting, Support …).
_shared.channels: Per-sales-channel links: the partner's external id in each connected shop / marketplace.
_shared.channels.externalId: The partner's id in that channel's external system.
_shared.items.purchasePrice: Net cost price (EK) of this line. The currency must match the document currency. Setting it overrides the price-list EK and is what the contribution margin is calculated from. Supplier price lists live on the PurchasePrice entity instead.
_shared.items.purchasePrice.currency: Currency of the cost price — must equal the document currency.
_shared.items.contributionMargin: Contribution margin of this line as a PERCENT of its net revenue ((net - purchase price) / net x 100), computed upstream from the line's purchasePrice — not an amount.
_shared.items.totals: Totals for the whole line quantity, as reported by Xentral (read-only). No tax amount: v3 states none per line — see the document totals for per-rate tax.
_shared.contacts.position: The contact's job title / function (e.g. Head of Purchasing).
_shared.contacts.subDepartment: Sub-department, where the company splits departments further.
_shared.contacts.internalNote: Internal note about the contact — not intended for the customer.
_shared.contacts.allowMarketingEmails: Whether the contact may receive marketing mail.

Customer.number: The merchant's own customer number. Settable on create — supply it to keep the number from your previous system, omit it to let Xentral draw one from the number range. It is filterable, so it is also the key that makes a repeated import idempotent. Not changeable afterwards.
Customer.type: Customer or lead (Interessent). Read-only: no v3 customers payload exposes the lead flag, so it cannot be set through the core today.
Customer.status: Lifecycle state of the customer: active or archived.
Customer.parent: Parent company in a branch → HQ hierarchy: this record is a branch of the referenced customer.
Customer.billTo: Central billing: invoices for this customer are addressed to this OTHER partner (e.g. a buying group or HQ). Null = billed directly.
Customer.name: Customer / company name (the main address name).
Customer.vatId: VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) for tax / reverse-charge handling.
Customer.project: Main project this customer is assigned to.
Customer.channel: Sales channel the customer originally came from.
Customer.defaults: Default commercial terms applied to this customer's new documents.
Customer.defaults.currency: Default currency for the customer's documents.
Customer.defaults.paymentMethod: Default payment method proposed on orders/invoices.
Customer.defaults.paymentTerms.dueDays: Net payment term in days — drives the due date and dunning.
Customer.defaults.paymentTerms.discountDays: Days within which the cash-discount applies.
Customer.defaults.taxation: Default tax scheme for this customer (domestic / EU B2B / EU OSS / export).
Customer.defaults.priceList: Price list assigned to this customer.
Customer.defaults.partialShipping: Whether the customer's orders may ship in partial deliveries.
Customer.finance: Read-only financial standing of the customer (A/R).
Customer.finance.openAmount: Total currently unpaid amount (open receivables) for this customer.
Customer.finance.creditLimit: Maximum outstanding amount allowed before orders are put on hold.
Customer.finance.onHold: Delivery/credit hold — when true, orders are blocked from fulfilment.
Customer.finance.dunningBlocked: Excludes the customer from the dunning (payment-reminder) run.
Customer.finance.debtorAccountNumber: Deviating debtor (A/R) account for the bookkeeping / DATEV export.
Customer.notes: Free-text note on the customer ("Sonstiges" in the mask) — the usual home for migrated CRM remarks.
Customer.customFields: Values of the company's custom fields (Freifelder) on this customer. `key` and `label` identify the field, `value` holds the content; `label` is required on write. Which fields exist is listed by the AddressCustomField entity. Note these are NOT filterable upstream — use `number` to match records on re-import.

Supplier.type: Kind of partner: person or company (salutation / legal form) — not the customer/supplier role.
Supplier.status: Lifecycle state of the supplier: active or archived.
Supplier.parent: Parent company in a branch → HQ hierarchy: this record is a branch of the referenced supplier.
Supplier.billTo: Central settlement: liabilities for this supplier are addressed to this OTHER partner. Null = settled directly.
Supplier.name: Supplier / company name (the main address name).
Supplier.vatId: VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) for tax / reverse-charge handling.
Supplier.project: Main project this supplier is assigned to.
Supplier.purchasing.ourCustomerNumber: Our customer number AT the supplier — how they identify us on their side.
Supplier.purchasing.confirmationRequired: Whether an order confirmation (AB) is required from this supplier.
Supplier.purchasing.sendOrdersVia: How purchase orders are sent to the supplier (email / portal / EDI).
Supplier.purchasing.deliveryDays: Standard supplier lead time in days (feeds replenishment planning).
Supplier.purchasing.minimumOrderValue: Minimum order value the supplier requires.
Supplier.defaults: Default commercial terms for purchasing from this supplier.
Supplier.defaults.currency: Default currency for the supplier's documents.
Supplier.defaults.paymentMethod: Default payment method for the supplier.
Supplier.defaults.paymentTerms: Default payment terms towards the supplier.
Supplier.finance: Read-only financial standing of the supplier (A/P).
Supplier.finance.openAmount: Total currently unpaid amount (open liabilities) towards this supplier.
Supplier.finance.creditorAccountNumber: Deviating creditor (A/P) account for the bookkeeping / DATEV export.

Quote.dates.validUntil: Date until which the quote and its prices remain valid.

Quote.dates.requestedDelivery: Delivery date requested by the customer.
Quote.billingAddress: Address the quote is billed to.
Quote.billingAddress.name: Name on the billing address.
Quote.billingAddress.street: Street and house number of the billing address.
Quote.billingAddress.zip: Postal code of the billing address.
Quote.billingAddress.country: ISO country code of the billing address (e.g. DE).
Quote.billingAddress.vatId: VAT id (USt-IdNr.) recorded on the document for tax handling.
Quote.shippingAddress: Deviating address the goods would ship to (null = same as billing).
Quote.shippingAddress.name: Name on the shipping address.
Quote.shippingAddress.street: Street and house number of the shipping address.
Quote.shippingAddress.zip: Postal code of the shipping address.
Quote.shippingAddress.country: ISO country code of the shipping address (e.g. DE).
Quote.shippingAddress.vatId: VAT id (USt-IdNr.) recorded on the shipping address.
Quote.items.position: Ordering position of the line on the document.
Quote.items.description: Free-text description of the line (extends or overrides the product name).
Quote.items.priceSource: Where the price was derived from, e.g. a price list (read-only).
Quote.items.taxRate: Tax rate key applied to the line.
Quote.items.isOptional: Marks the line as an optional item the customer may add.
Quote.payment: Payment method and terms proposed on the quote.
Quote.payment.terms: Payment terms (net due days plus cash-discount).
Quote.payment.terms.discountDays: Days within which the cash-discount applies.
Quote.texts: Free-text blocks printed on the document.
Quote.texts.intro: Introductory text printed above the line items.
Quote.texts.outro: Closing text printed below the line items.
Quote.note: Internal comment (not printed on the document).
Quote.documents: Follow-up documents created from this quote (read-only).
Quote.documents.salesOrders: Sales orders created from this quote.
Quote.number: The quote number, drawn from the configured number range. It cannot be supplied: the v3 create does not accept a number for this document type.

SalesOrder.customer: The customer the order is for.
SalesOrder.channel: Sales channel the order came in through.
SalesOrder.project: Project the order is assigned to.
SalesOrder.references: External / customer reference numbers on the order.
SalesOrder.references.customerOrderNumber: The customer's own order number / PO reference.
SalesOrder.references.externalId: Order id in the connected external system (shop / marketplace).
SalesOrder.references.externalNumber: Order number in the connected external system.
SalesOrder.references.paymentTransactionId: Payment provider's transaction id for the order.
SalesOrder.dates.requestedDelivery: Delivery date requested by the customer.
SalesOrder.dates.earliestFulfillment: Earliest date the order may be fulfilled / shipped.
SalesOrder.dates.reservation: Date until which stock is reserved for the order.
SalesOrder.dates.confirmedDelivery: Delivery date confirmed back to the customer (read-only).
SalesOrder.billingAddress: Address the order is billed to.
SalesOrder.billingAddress.name: Name on the billing address.
SalesOrder.billingAddress.street: Street and house number of the billing address.
SalesOrder.billingAddress.zip: Postal code of the billing address.
SalesOrder.billingAddress.country: ISO country code of the billing address (e.g. DE).
SalesOrder.billingAddress.vatId: VAT id (USt-IdNr.) recorded on the document for tax handling.
SalesOrder.shippingAddress: Deviating address the goods ship to (null = same as billing).
SalesOrder.shippingAddress.name: Name on the shipping address.
SalesOrder.shippingAddress.street: Street and house number of the shipping address.
SalesOrder.shippingAddress.zip: Postal code of the shipping address.
SalesOrder.shippingAddress.country: ISO country code of the shipping address (e.g. DE).
SalesOrder.shippingAddress.vatId: VAT id (USt-IdNr.) recorded on the shipping address.
SalesOrder.items: Order line items. On UPDATE this REPLACES the line-item set: an item with an existing items.id is changed, one without an id is added, and any existing item you omit is removed. Send the full desired list (echo back the ids you want to keep).
SalesOrder.items.position: Ordering position of the line on the document.
SalesOrder.items.description: Free-text description of the line (extends or overrides the product name).
SalesOrder.items.priceSource: Where the price was derived from, e.g. a price list (read-only).
SalesOrder.items.taxRate: Tax rate key applied to the line.
SalesOrder.items.warehouse: Warehouse the line is fulfilled from.
SalesOrder.items.fulfillment.shipped: Quantity of the line already shipped.
SalesOrder.items.fulfillment.invoiced: Quantity of the line already invoiced.
SalesOrder.items.fulfillment.returned: Quantity of the line already returned.
SalesOrder.totals.taxes.base: Net amount the tax is calculated on.
SalesOrder.payment.terms: Payment terms (net due days plus cash-discount).
SalesOrder.payment.terms.discountDays: Days within which the cash-discount applies.
SalesOrder.fulfillmentPolicy: Rules governing how the order is fulfilled.
SalesOrder.fulfillmentPolicy.auto: Whether the order dispatches automatically without manual release.
SalesOrder.fulfillmentPolicy.priority: Fulfilment priority (e.g. normal, high / fast lane).
SalesOrder.holds: Active fulfilment blocks — the curated reasons a dispatch would be rejected (read-only). Empty means nothing blocks. A 'stock' hold means an item is not in stock; check each line's product.stock.available to find which one.
SalesOrder.holds.type: Kind of block: stock (item not available), creditLimit, manual (delivery block), or address.
SalesOrder.holds.state: The blocking signal's raw state (e.g. false / no).
SalesOrder.trafficLights: All fulfilment signals of the order, raw and uninterpreted (read-only) — the same 'Ampeln' the UI shows. `holds` is the curated blocking subset; this is the full set (stock, payment, creditLimit, deliveryBlock, addressValidation, vat, …) so you can see every green/red signal.
SalesOrder.trafficLights.id: Signal name, e.g. stock, stockAvailableFifo, payment, creditLimit, deliveryBlock, addressValidation.
SalesOrder.trafficLights.state: Signal state as reported upstream (true/false or a string like fullyPaid / no).
SalesOrder.texts: Free-text blocks printed on the document.
SalesOrder.texts.intro: Introductory text printed above the line items.
SalesOrder.texts.outro: Closing text printed below the line items.
SalesOrder.note: Internal comment (not printed on the document).
SalesOrder.documents: Linked documents in the order's flow (read-only).
SalesOrder.documents.quote: Quote this order was created from.
SalesOrder.documents.deliveryNotes: Delivery notes created from this order.
SalesOrder.discounts: Document-level discounts applied to the order (read-only).
SalesOrder.number: The sales order number. Supply it on create to carry a number over from a previous system — Xentral stores it verbatim and it survives release. Omit it and the next number is drawn from the configured range. It cannot be changed afterwards; the number must be unique.

GoodsReceipt.items: Received line items (products, quantities and where they were stored).
GoodsReceipt.items.quantity.unit: Unit of measure for the received quantity.
GoodsReceipt.items.storageLocation: Storage location the item was put away to.
GoodsReceipt.documents: Read-only links to the documents this receipt relates to.
GoodsReceipt.documents.purchaseOrder: The purchase order this receipt fulfils.
GoodsReceipt.documents.returnOrder: The return order this receipt belongs to (returned goods).
GoodsReceipt.documents.salesOrder: The sales order linked to this receipt (e.g. dropship / return).
GoodsReceipt.documents.parcelReceipt: The parcel-receipt record this goods receipt originated from.

PurchaseInvoice.status: Workflow state of the supplier invoice: received, matched, approved, paid, or rejected.
PurchaseInvoice.supplier: The supplier who issued the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.costCenter: Cost center the invoice is booked against.
PurchaseInvoice.references: External references on the supplier invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.references.supplierInvoiceNumber: The invoice number printed on the supplier's document.
PurchaseInvoice.references.externalReference: Additional external reference for the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.references.creditorAccountNumber: Creditor (A/P) account the invoice is booked to.
PurchaseInvoice.dates.invoiceDate: Date the supplier issued the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.dates.received: Date the invoice was entered / received by us.
PurchaseInvoice.dates.serviceDate: Date the goods or services were supplied (tax point).
PurchaseInvoice.clarification: Read-only flag for invoices held for clarification.
PurchaseInvoice.clarification.needed: Whether the invoice needs clarification before it can proceed.
PurchaseInvoice.clarification.reason: Why the invoice is in clarification.
PurchaseInvoice.items: Invoiced line items (products, quantities and prices).
PurchaseInvoice.items.quantity.unit: Unit of measure for the quantity.
PurchaseInvoice.items.unitPrice: Net price per unit on the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.totals.paid: Amount already paid on the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.match: Read-only three-way match between order, goods receipt and invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.match.status: Overall match result: pending, matched, or mismatch.
PurchaseInvoice.match.goodsCheck: Goods-receipt check result of the match.
PurchaseInvoice.match.invoiceCheck: Invoice check result of the match.
PurchaseInvoice.match.purchaseOrder: The purchase order the invoice is matched against.
PurchaseInvoice.payment: Payment method, terms and status for the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.payment.method: Payment method used to settle the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.payment.dueDate: Date the invoice is payable by.
PurchaseInvoice.payment.discountUntil: Last date the cash-discount (Skonto) can be taken.
PurchaseInvoice.payment.status: Payment state of the invoice (e.g. open, paid).
PurchaseInvoice.files: Read-only attached documents (original invoice / OCR files).
PurchaseInvoice.files.name: File name of the attachment.
PurchaseInvoice.documents.purchaseOrder: The purchase order this invoice belongs to.
PurchaseInvoice.approval: Read-only approval state of the invoice.
PurchaseInvoice.approval.status: Approval / check status of the invoice.

Channel.platform: The e-commerce platform / marketplace the channel runs on (shopify, amazon, ebay, …).
Channel.defaults: Default settings applied to orders from this channel.
Channel.defaults.priceList: Price list used for this channel's orders.
Channel.defaults.warehouse: Warehouse orders from this channel are fulfilled from.
Channel.name: Display name of the sales channel.
Channel.type: Kind of channel: shop, marketplace, direct, or pos.
Channel.active: Whether the channel is currently active.
Channel.sync: Read-only status of the channel's last sync run.
Channel.sync.lastRunAt: Timestamp of the last sync run.
Channel.sync.status: Result of the last sync run (success / failure).

Product.status: Lifecycle state of the product: active, inactive (disabled), or archived (deleted).
Product.statusReason: Free-text reason the product is disabled / inactive.
Product.kind: What the product represents: physical good, service, digital, shippingCost, or fee.
Product.name: Product name shown on documents and in the shop.
Product.unit: Unit of measure the product is sold in (e.g. piece, kg, litre).
Product.category: Merchandise group the product belongs to.
Product.project: Project the product is assigned to.
Product.identifiers: External and regulatory identifiers of the product.
Product.identifiers.ean: EAN / GTIN barcode of the product.
Product.identifiers.hsCode: Customs tariff (HS) number for cross-border shipping.
Product.identifiers.countryOfOrigin: ISO country code where the product was manufactured.
Product.identifiers.external: Per-channel product ids in connected shops / marketplaces.
Product.identifiers.external.id: The product's id in that channel's external system.
Product.manufacturer.name: Manufacturer / brand name.
Product.prices: Sale and purchase prices of the product.
Product.prices.sale: The product's single standard sale (list) price. Customer-specific, customer-group and scale/tiered (Staffel) prices are NOT set here — use the PriceList entity for those.
Product.prices.sale.amount: Standard sale price amount. Setting it on update supersedes the previous standard price (one effective price + history).
Product.prices.sale.currency: Currency of the standard sale price.
Product.prices.purchase: Calculated purchase (cost) price of the product.
Product.prices.purchase.source: How the purchase price was derived (e.g. calculated, manual, supplier).
Product.tax.rate: VAT rate band applied to the product: standard, reduced, or exempt.
Product.tax.profile: Named tax profile / account assignment for the product.
Product.logistics: Physical dimensions and stocking / ordering rules of the product.
Product.logistics.weight.unit: Unit of the gross weight (e.g. kg).
Product.logistics.netWeight: Net weight of the product (without packaging).
Product.logistics.netWeight.unit: Unit of the net weight (e.g. kg).
Product.logistics.minimumOrderQuantity: Smallest quantity that can be ordered on a sales document.
Product.logistics.minimumStockQuantity: Minimum stock level before replenishment is triggered.
Product.logistics.packagingUnits: Packaging tiers the product is bundled in (e.g. box, pallet).
Product.logistics.packagingUnits.quantity: Number of base units contained in this packaging unit.
Product.tracking: How stock movements of the product are tracked.
Product.tracking.stock: Whether the product is a stock-tracked item.
Product.tracking.batches: Whether the product is tracked by batch / lot.
Product.tracking.serialNumbers: Serial-number tracking mode for the product.
Product.tracking.bestBefore: Whether the product carries a best-before (expiry) date.
Product.stock: Read-only stock figures, all in the product's own unit (see `unit`) — the numbers are bare, they carry no unit of their own. Filled on a single read only; in a list every figure is null. `physical` is what lies on the shelf, `available` what may still be sold; they are NOT the same number.
Product.production: In-house / external production characteristics of the product.
Product.production.mode: How the product is produced: none, inHouse, external, or justInTime.
Product.production.hasBillOfMaterials: Whether the product has a bill of materials.
Product.documentDefaults: Defaults applied when the product is placed on a document.
Product.documentDefaults.hidePrice: Hide the product's price on printed documents.
Product.documentDefaults.noticeText: Standard notice / note text added for this product.
Product.documentDefaults.requiresCustomerApprova: Whether the product line needs explicit customer approval.
Product.variant: Variant / matrix relationship of the product.
Product.variant.of: Parent product this record is a variant of.
Product.variant.isMatrix: True when the product is a matrix (variant parent) product.
Product.bom: Bill of materials of the product.
Product.bom.items: Component lines making up the product.
Product.bom.items.product: Component product used in the assembly.
Product.bom.items.quantity: Quantity of the component needed per finished unit.
Product.suppliers: Suppliers from whom the product can be purchased.
Product.suppliers.supplierProductNumber: The supplier's own article number for this product.
Product.suppliers.isDefault: Marks the standard (preferred) supplier for the product.

PriceList.entries: Tiered price rows of the list (product x min quantity -> unit price).
PriceList.entries.product: Product the price row applies to.
PriceList.entries.minQuantity: Minimum quantity from which this tier's price applies.
PriceList.product: Product this price entry applies to.
PriceList.scope: Who the price applies to: a specific customer, a customer group, or neither (a plain standard price — prefer setting that on Product.prices.sale). Provide customer or customerGroup, not both.
PriceList.scope.customer: Specific customer the price is granted to (null = applies broadly).
PriceList.scope.customerGroup: Customer group the price applies to (the customer-group id; e.g. 1 = the default group). Xentral validates the id and rejects an unknown one.
PriceList.minQuantity: Minimum order quantity from which this price applies (staffel/tier threshold). Several entries with different minQuantity form a scale price.
PriceList.unitPrice: Price per unit for this entry.
PriceList.unitPrice.taxRate: Tax rate type applied to derive the gross price.
PriceList.validFrom: Date from which the price is effective.
PriceList.validUntil: Date after which the price expires.
PriceList.remark: Free-text note on the price entry.

Shipment.status: Delivery state of the shipment: label, handedOver, inTransit, delivered, exception, or returned.
Shipment.carrier: Carrier handling the shipment (e.g. DHL, UPS).
Shipment.trackingUrl: Carrier tracking link for the shipment.
Shipment.labelUrl: URL of the generated shipping label.
Shipment.weight.unit: Unit of the shipment weight (e.g. kg).
Shipment.packages.trackingNumber: Tracking number of the individual parcel.
Shipment.events: Carrier tracking history of the shipment.
Shipment.events.status: Status reported by the carrier at this event.
Shipment.events.location: Location reported by the carrier at this event.
Shipment.shippingMethod: Shipping method / carrier service used for the shipment.
Shipment.tracking: Primary tracking details of the shipment.
Shipment.tracking.link: Carrier tracking link for the shipment.
Shipment.additionalPackages: Extra parcels beyond the primary one in the shipment.
Shipment.additionalPackages.trackingNumber: Tracking number of the additional parcel.
Shipment.documents.deliveryNote: Delivery note the shipment was created from.
Shipment.documents.salesOrder: Sales order the shipment ultimately fulfils.

Payment.direction: Whether the payment is incoming (received) or outgoing (paid).
Payment.fees: Transaction fee deducted (e.g. PSP / bank charge).
Payment.unallocated: Amount of the payment not yet allocated to any invoice.
Payment.kind: Nature of the payment: incoming, outgoing, refund, or chargeback.
Payment.method: Payment method used (e.g. bank transfer, PayPal, credit card).
Payment.reference: Bank / PSP reference or purpose text of the transaction.
Payment.bookedAt: Timestamp the payment was booked in accounting.
Payment.allocations: Links matching this payment to the invoices it settles.
Payment.allocations.invoice: Invoice this portion of the payment is allocated to.
Payment.allocations.amount: Amount of the payment applied to this invoice.

StockMovement.date: Effective date of the movement (defaults to the booking time).
StockMovement.type: Kind of movement: receipt (goods in), issue (goods out), transfer (between locations), or correction.
StockMovement.product: The product whose stock this movement changes.
StockMovement.quantity.value: Quantity moved (signed by type — positive in, negative out).
StockMovement.quantity.unit: Unit of measure the quantity is expressed in.
StockMovement.from: Source storage location the stock left (empty for a pure receipt).
StockMovement.to: Destination storage location the stock entered (empty for a pure issue).
StockMovement.batch: The batch / lot this movement applies to, for batch-managed products.
StockMovement.unitCost.amount: Valuation cost per unit at the time of the movement.
StockMovement.source.document: The document that triggered this movement (e.g. a delivery note or goods receipt).
StockMovement.source.user: The user who booked or caused the movement.
StockMovement.source.reason: Free-text reason, mainly for manual corrections.
StockMovement.bookedAt: Timestamp the movement was actually posted to stock.

StorageLocation.status: Whether the location is usable (active) or blocked from picking/putaway.
StorageLocation.name: Location designation / bin label (e.g. 'A-01-03').
StorageLocation.warehouse: The warehouse this location belongs to.
StorageLocation.kind: Purpose of the location: picking, bulk, inbound, returns, or quarantine.
StorageLocation.pickingOrder: Sort rank that defines the walking sequence when picking this warehouse.
StorageLocation.capacity.maxWeight.value: Maximum load this location may hold.
StorageLocation.capacity.note: Free-text note on capacity or handling restrictions.
StorageLocation.contents.product: A product currently stored in this location.
StorageLocation.contents.batch: The batch / lot of that stored product, if batch-managed.
StorageLocation.contents.quantity.value: Physical quantity of that product/batch at this location.
StorageLocation.contents.reserved.value: Portion of that quantity already reserved for orders.

StockTake.dates.keyDate: Effective inventory (cut-off) date the count reflects.
StockTake.dates.posted: When the count was posted and differences booked to stock.
StockTake.totals.positions: Number of positions in the count.
StockTake.totals.differences: Number of positions where counted quantity deviated from expected.
StockTake.name: Name / title of the stock take run.
StockTake.status: Lifecycle state: draft, counting, review, posted, or cancelled.
StockTake.scope.storageLocations: Which storage locations are in scope (a count, or 'all').
StockTake.positions.storageLocation: Storage location of this counted position.
StockTake.positions.difference.value: Counted minus expected — the inventory difference to book.
StockTake.documents.stockMovements: Stock movements generated when the count was posted (difference bookings).

PickingRun.criteria.channel: Sales channel used to select the orders gathered into this run.
PickingRun.criteria.shippingMethod: Shipping method used to select the orders gathered into this run.
PickingRun.orders: The sales orders whose items are collected in this run.
PickingRun.containers.name: Name / label of a tote or bin assigned to the run.
PickingRun.name: Name / title of the picking run.
PickingRun.status: Lifecycle state: draft, released, inProgress, picked, completed, or cancelled.
PickingRun.strategy: Picking strategy: single order, multiOrder, wave, or zone.
PickingRun.warehouse: The warehouse the run is picked in.
PickingRun.assignedTo.name: Name of a picker assigned to the run.
PickingRun.progress.deliveryNotes: Number of delivery notes covered by the run.
PickingRun.progress.products: Number of product lines to pick.
PickingRun.progress.totalWeight: Total weight of the goods to pick.
PickingRun.tasks.status: State of this individual pick task (e.g. open / picked).
PickingRun.tasks.storageLocation: Location the picker walks to for this task.
PickingRun.tasks.product: Product to pick for this task.
PickingRun.tasks.quantity.value: Quantity to pick for this task.
PickingRun.documents.deliveryNotes: Delivery notes produced / fulfilled by this run.

Batch.product: The product this batch / lot belongs to.
Batch.bestBefore: Best-before / expiry date of the batch.
Batch.status: Whether the batch is released for use or blocked from stock movements.
Batch.stock.available: Quantity of this batch currently available.
Batch.stock.reserved: Quantity of this batch reserved for orders.
Batch.trace.goodsReceipts: Goods receipts that brought this batch into stock (inbound trace).
Batch.trace.deliveryNotes: Delivery notes that shipped this batch out (outbound trace).

Tag.label: Human-readable name of the tag as shown in the UI.
Tag.slug: Machine-safe identifier of the tag (URL / key form of the label).
Tag.color: Display color of the tag badge.
Tag.group: The tag group / category this tag belongs to.

PaymentMethod.type: Technical payment type (e.g. amazon, paypal, prepayment) — the value documents reference.
PaymentMethod.project: Project/client the payment method is bound to; null = instance-wide.

ShippingMethod.module: Shipping module handling this method (e.g. dhl, ups).
ShippingMethod.shippingEmailBehaviour: When the shipping confirmation email is sent for this method.
ShippingMethod.supportsDeliveries: Whether this method can be used on outbound deliveries.
ShippingMethod.supportsReturns: Whether this method can be used for returns.

ReturnReason.language: 2-letter ISO language code this reason's wording is maintained in.

PaymentTermsGroup.key: Stable machine key of the group — the value documents reference.
PaymentTermsGroup.paymentTerms.postageFreeFrom: Order value from which postage is free.

TaxRate.country: ISO-2 country the rates apply to. Filter with equals; default DE. The upstream keys rates by country, so cross-country listing needs one query per country.
TaxRate.id: Positional per listing (no upstream id) — do not persist across calls.
TaxRate.date: Date the rate is valid on; filter to query historical rates.
TaxRate.product: Product-specific rate override; null = the country-wide rate.

Warehouse.project: Project/client the warehouse belongs to; null = instance-wide.

Project.keyName: Stable machine key of the project (number-range prefix).
Project.normalTaxRate: Default standard tax rate in percent for documents in this project.
Project.reducedTaxRate: Default reduced tax rate in percent for documents in this project.
Project.storageProcess: Warehouse process this project runs (e.g. standard, expressPicking).

User.contactId: Address/contact record linked to this login, if any.
User.globalUserId: Cross-instance UUID of the user account.
User.isAdmin: Whether the user has instance-admin rights.

Employee.number: Employee number from the HR master data.

ProductCategory.parent: Parent category; null for a root category (the tree is built from these links).

MerchandiseGroup.lastUsedProductNumber: Most recently assigned product number in this group's own number range.
MerchandiseGroup.useMainProductNumberRange: true = products in this group draw from the main number range instead of a group-specific one.

ProductTag.color: Display color of the tag badge. Distinct from the document Tag catalogue.

ProductFreeField.name: Free-field name as it appears on the product form; values live on each product.

AddressCustomField.type: Input type of the custom field (single_line, multi_line, date, checkbox, select).
AddressCustomField.allowedValues: For select fields: the permitted label/value pairs.

Webhook.url: Receiver endpoint Xentral POSTs the event payloads to.
Webhook.events: Event types this webhook is subscribed to (see WebhookEventType for the catalogue).

WebhookEventType.id: Fully-qualified event name (e.g. com.xentral.salesOrder.created.v1) — the value Webhook.events references.
WebhookEventType.group: Business object the event belongs to (salesOrder, product, …).

TextTemplate.documentType: Document type the template applies to; the record id is tpl_<documentType>.
TextTemplate.header: Text above the item table (HTML, may contain placeholder variables).
TextTemplate.footer: Text at the document end (HTML, may contain placeholder variables).
TextTemplate.disableStationery: true = the letterhead/stationery PDF background is suppressed for this type.

Correspondence.type: Entry kind. email here is a LOG entry only — a real send goes through the email tool; ticket/document come from their integrations and are read-only.
Correspondence.customer: Customer whose CRM tab the entry appears on (upstream recipientAddress).
Correspondence.date: Filterable with equals/notEquals only (upstream rejects range ops). Defaults to today on create.
Correspondence.time: Defaults to now (Europe/Berlin) on create; HH:MM is padded to HH:MM:SS.
Correspondence.isSent: Whether an email entry was actually dispatched (set by the send pipeline).

Printer.connection: How the printer is reached (cups, download, spooler, adapterbox, …).
Printer.useCase: What the printer is routed for (shipping labels, shipping documents, other).
Printer.id: Target for the printDocument action — a run creates a REAL print job.

EmailAccount.email: Sender address of this account — the sendEmail action sends from it.
EmailAccount.isSystemDefault: The account Xentral uses when no explicit sender is picked — prefer it when the user names no account.
EmailAccount.projects: Projects/clients this account is bound to.
